Definition: from G2117; to straighten (level); technically, to steer:--governor, make straight.
BiblicalUsage: The word euthýnō carries the sense of governor, make straight. In John 1:23, the text says "Make straight the way of the Lord."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, euthýnō, does its job quietly — governor, make straight — and I leave it at that.
